min_wage_2026.note: National minimum wage from 1 January 2026, set by Decreto nº 12.797 (signed 24 Dec 2025, published in the Diário Oficial da União), a 6.79% increase over the 2025 floor of R$1,518. Calculated per the Política de Valorização do Salário Mínimo formula: prior-12-month INPC inflation (4.18%) plus real GDP growth from two years prior (capped).

min_wage_2x.note: 2x min_wage_2026 (1,621 x 2 = 3,242). Used for the VITEM V work visa's salary floor.

sources.title: Reporting on Decreto nº 12.797, signed by President Lula and published in the Diário Oficial da União 24 Dec 2025, fixing the 2026 minimum wage at R$1,621/month effective 1 Jan 2026 -- multiple independent news sources (CNN Brasil, Sistema FENACON) corroborate the same decree number and figure identically, but this is journalism describing the decree, not a direct fetch of planalto.gov.br or in.gov.br (the official gazette) itself -- flagged honestly as tier 3 rather than upgraded on the strength of the underlying instrument being a real, identifiable government decree
